errors.evidence: The pie chart contains five sectors, not six.

errors.text_span: Секторите са етикетирани като "0-5%“ (син), „5-10%“ (червен), „10-15%“ (жълт), „15-20%“ (зелен), "9.5%"(лилав) и "Повече от 20%" (синьо).
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors. It lists six categories for five sectors. It incorrectly identifies "9.5%" as a category label from the legend, when it is actually the value of the purple slice, whose label is "Повече от 20%". It then hallucinates a sixth category, assigning the label "Повече от 20%" to the color blue, when this label actually corresponds to the purple slice.

This statement is misleading because it implies that only the 23.8% sector has its value labeled inside. In fact, all five sectors have their percentage values explicitly written inside them (33.3%, 14.3%, 23.8%, 19%, and 9.5%).

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени визуално по низходящ размер, започвайки от "Повече от 20%" и завършвайки с "0-5%".
errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. Their values are 33.3%, 14.3%, 23.8%, 19%, and 9.5%, and they are not arranged sequentially by size around the circle. Furthermore, the statement incorrectly identifies the smallest sector ("Повече от 20%" which is 9.5%) as the starting point and the largest sector ("0-5%" which is 33.3%) as the end point of this non-existent order.

The description fails to state the percentage value for each category as shown inside the slices. For example, it does not mention that the category "0-5%" corresponds to the value 33.3%, "5-10%" corresponds to 14.3%, etc. It only lists the category labels from the legend without connecting them to their specific data values shown on the chart.
